description: Writes down what is said in a recording, with each segment's start and end in seconds. Give url (a public https link or an upload_media link) or data (the file as base64, up to 20 MB). MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG, M4A, MP4 or MOV. For captions, pass the answer's id to edit_video as captions { transcription_id } (kept 48 hours); words true also returns every word's timing here. Billed per minute of the recording as we measure it; see list_models. The same request again within 10 minutes is the same call, not a second charge.

data.description: Or the file itself, base64-encoded (a data: URL works too).

language.description: ISO-639-1 code, e.g. en; detected when left out.

model.description: A transcription model from list_models (kind audio); the first one when left out.

prompt.description: Spelling hints: names and terms that occur in the recording.

run_again.description: Transcribe it anew even if the same request was just made.

url.description: The recording: a public https link or an upload_media link.

words.description: true: also return every word's start and end (long for a long recording). Default false: captions take the id instead.

name: transcribe

id.description: Give it to edit_video as captions { transcription_id }.

status.description: succeeded, or running: then call transcribe again with the same arguments (the same call, no new charge).

title: Transcribe
